subject: Post-demo follow-up: SDK/Streaming integration playbook & owners
messages:
From: Tara Emmons <tara.emmons@helixhealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Chris Ng <cng@helixhealth.com>, procurement@helixhealth.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + next steps (Helix Health + Redwood)

Sofia / team —

Thanks for the demo earlier. High level takeaways from our side:
- Redwood streaming and tool-calling look promising for our triage assistant use case.
- Main concern: auditability of structured outputs and retention settings for PHI-adjacent logs.
- We need a concrete integration plan that maps milestones to owners and highlights any procurement or security gating items.

Can you send a concise MAP-style plan so we can review with engineering and procurement? Our target is an end-of-July pilot with a potential GA signoff in mid-September.

Attachments: I uploaded our scoping doc to the shared drive (link in email).

Tara
Director, Product
HelixHealth

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Tara Emmons <tara.emmons@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 16:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + next steps (Helix Health + Redwood)

Tara — thanks for the quick summary and the timeline. Below is a compact Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the integration milestone "SDK + Streaming + Structured Outputs" so your engineering and procurement teams can map responsibilities. I attached a one-page MAP PDF and an integration checklist spreadsheet for tracking.

High level target:
- Pilot start: 2026-07-26
- Pilot scope: core triage flows (chat -> tool calls -> structured outputs saved to secure bucket)
- Target GA decision: 2026-09-15

MAP: Integration build milestone (owner assignments + dependencies)
1) Authentication & Network (Week 1-2)
   - Owner (Helix): Net/Cloud lead (Chris Ng) — configure VPC peering, firewall rules, and service endpoints.
   - Owner (Redwood): Ben Carter — provide VPC configuration template, test endpoints, and KMS integration doc.
   - Dependencies: procurement of dedicated capacity OR approved hosted plan; SOC2 paperwork in flight.

2) SDK integration (Week 2-4)
   - Owner (Helix): Integration engineer (TBD) — embed Redwood SDK into triage backend, implement token refresh.
   - Owner (Redwood): Marissa Cole — SDK sample repo, sanity tests, and code walkthrough session.
   - Deliverable: working SDK client in staging; baseline latency numbers.

3) Streaming + KV cache tuning (Week 3-5)
   - Owner (Helix): Platform engineer — validate chunked responses, ensure reconnect logic.
   - Owner (Redwood): Ben Carter — provide recommended batching profiles, autoscale guidance, and a streaming test harness.
   - Dependencies: agreed latency SLO and sequence length distribution; access to representative prompt set.

4) Tool calling and structured outputs (Week 4-6)
   - Owner (Helix): Backend lead — implement tool-call endpoints and store structured outputs to the audit bucket.
   - Owner (Redwood): Sofia Ivanova — tool-calling patterns, example schemas for structured outputs, and QoE test prompt set.
   - Deliverable: schema-validated structured outputs and sample index for search.

5) Security/compliance validation (Week 5-7)
   - Owner (Helix): Security — run checklist against SOC2 controls and retention settings.
   - Owner (Redwood): Ben Carter — provide evidence artifacts, audit logs export, and assist with KMS/HSM questions.

6) Pilot validation + go/no-go (Week 7-9)
   - Owner (Helix): PM + Eng leads — run acceptance scenarios; signoff on performance and compliance criteria.
   - Owner (Redwood): Marissa + Sofia — monitor pilot, suggest tuning, and prepare GA packaging notes.

Callouts / blockers:
- Procurement: need signed SOW or PO for dedicated capacity if you require reserved instances; procurement contact looped on this thread.
- Data residency / retention: provide your target retention policy so we can confirm configuration options and any required Private deployment steps.
- Test data: please share a redacted prompt set (or synthetic equivalent) for KV/cache tuning.

Attachments: HLX-MAP-draft-v0.2.pdf (one-page MAP), integration-checklist.xlsx (tracking matrix)

Proposed next steps:
- Quick sync (30 min) next Tue or Wed to confirm owners (we'll keep Marissa and Ben on the call for SDK/streaming details).
- I will update the MAP after we confirm the Helix engineer assignment and procurement timeline.

If that looks good I'll schedule the sync and post a calendar invite.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Sr. Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Tara Emmons <tara.emmons@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up: SDK/Streaming integration playbook & owners

Adding a few engineering-level clarifications to the MAP so Helix can scope tasks more precisely: 

SDK integration specifics:
- We provide a small language-client (python + node) with examples for token refresh, bulk embedding calls, and optional structured-output schema enforcement.
- Acceptance criteria: sample harness runs with <150ms median token latency in staging and correct end-to-end tool-call flow.

Streaming + batching notes:
- For low-latency interactive flows we recommend continuous batching disabled for the first 4 tokens (hot-start) then enabled for background inference in long-lived sessions.
- We will supply a streaming test harness and a 'stress profile' that simulates 50 concurrent triage agents.

Structured outputs / schema validation:
- We'll propose JSON Schema examples for your triage output (intent, severity, recommended action, evidence refs).
- Redwood can run automated regression checks on the schema against the pilot prompts and raise quality alerts if distributions shift.

Sofia: Ben and I can prep the SDK example repo and a 45-min walkthrough the day after the sync.

Marissa
Principal Engineering Manager
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up: SDK/Streaming integration playbook & owners

Appreciate the rapid turnaround — this MAP is helpful and gives us a clear runway. A few quick notes from our side:
- Confirmed: procurement can aim to issue a PO for pilot capacity next week (probable hosted plan, will confirm if we need dedicated).
- Security will run the SOC2 artifact checklist; I expect questions around retention windows.
- I'll assign our integration engineer (Lina Park) and confirm by Monday.

Let's do Tue 06/22 at 10:00 PT for the 30-min sync — Marissa, Sofia, Ben: can you confirm?

Chris
VP, Platform Engineering
HelixHealth
